verdict.rationale: The CRA is a government service platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or any agent-facing integration. The only programmatic channel documented is EFILE, which works through certified tax software and is not an MCP server. Probes also confirm canada.ca publishes no llms.txt or other agent-oriented docs index.
